Degraded states

The honesty patterns, collected — because they are the product, not the edge case
COVERS   the batch-1 surfaces
READS    spec §D5 · §D6 · §D7
PARTS    sheets 01 · 02
DATE     2026-07-29

Four rules generate every frame on this sheet

01
Missing data is a sentence

Never an error, never an icon, never a dash where a sentence would do. The app says what it does not know, in the same voice it says everything else.

02
A sum that would lie is withheld

Zero and unknown are different facts and get different treatments. 0,00 € is a real sum of nothing; 0 km would be an invention.

03
The surface never turns red

Being late, being over, being offline, being unmeasured — all facts, all attention at most. Critical is text only, and only for a destructive confirmation or a hard validation error.

04
A degraded row is still a row

No dimming, no warning tint, no apology. If a state is drawn to look broken, users treat their own honest data as a mistake they made.

01 · Nothing yet

Empty is not the same as broken, and "quiet" is not the same as "empty" — the two get different copy on purpose.
HOME · NO FILLS EVER
LAST FILL
No fills yet. Log one and Koi starts measuring.
The card keeps its label and its place. A card that vanishes teaches nothing about what would fill it.
HOME · A MONTH WITH NO READINGS
AUGUST
—0,00 €
No readings this month.
Three treatments on one strip. Money is a real zero. Distance is a dash plus a sentence. €/km disappears entirely — a rate with an unknown denominator is not a number Koi has.
CAR PAGE · FIELDS NOT ON FILE
5678-DEF
Seat Ibiza · 2014
Tank and power not on file
Not "—", not an empty row, not a nag to complete your profile. One faint sentence, and the page moves on.
SECOND DEVICE · SYNC ON, NOTHING ARRIVED
魚
Waiting for your records to arrive.
The easiest empty state to miss. A signed-in second device must not read Add your car to begin — that invites the duplicate-car outcome the architecture deliberately will not auto-resolve.

02 · Measured, partly measured, unmeasured

Five fuel rows, five saved moments, one rule: the app never claims a number it does not have, and never apologises for not having it.
THE SAME ROW DESIGN, READING FIVE DATA SITUATIONS
Repsol Tarragona6,9 L/100km · 378 km 35,75 €12 Jul
Cepsa Salou16,80 L · no odometer 24,00 €24 Jul
BP Reuspartial · 18,20 L 30,00 €25 Jun
Repsol Reus42,10 L · a fill was missed before this one 66,80 €4 Jun
Fill-upGolf GTI 54,20 €11 May

Measured · no odometer · partial · missed-previous · money-only. Identical weight, identical colour, identical everything. The meta line changes and nothing else does. A user scanning this list cannot tell which rows Koi "prefers", which is the point — the ledger is theirs, and the app does not grade it.

AND THE MOMENT THAT FOLLOWS EACH ONE
SITUATION
WHAT THE APP SAYS
measured
Saved. Economy computed. · 6,9 L/100km · over 378 km
no odometer
Saved. Add the odometer to measure this interval. — and the record page offers to, on this exact fill
partial
Saved. Economy resumes at the next full tank.
missed previous
Saved. That interval isn't measured.
first fill ever
Saved. Two full tanks measure your first number.
fewer than 3 measured
the Per fill chart is replaced by the stat table — a two-point trend is refused outright, not drawn faintly

Every one of these is a Saved. None is a warning. The sentence after it explains what the ledger can and cannot measure — which is teaching, and it happens exactly once, at the moment the user has the context to understand it.

03 · Late, over, refused, gone

The states most apps paint red. Two of them earn attention; one earns critical text; one earns nothing at all.
OVERDUE · ATTENTION
ITVInspection · Golf GTI 12 days over
Was due 16 July 2026
Mark done Snooze +7
Being late is a fact. Past tense, a count of days, and two ways out. No exclamation mark, no red, no badge on the tab bar.
OVER CAP · ATTENTION
1.840 / 1.760 km 23 JUL – 22 AUG
1.500 cap + 260 carried over from June.
80 km over your pooled budget.
At your pace, ≈2.035 km by 22 August.
Never hidden, counted in text, present tense. The gauge fills attention rather than turning the card a colour, and the pace line keeps working — over-cap does not mean stop reporting.
HARD VALIDATION · CRITICAL TEXT ONLY
ODOMETER
90.100km
A reading on 12 July says 91.240 km.
Open that record
The one place critical is earned outside a destructive confirmation — and even here it is a border and a line of text, never a filled banner. It names the conflict and offers the door to it.
DELETED ELSEWHERE · NO COLOUR AT ALL
This car is not on this device. It may have been deleted somewhere else.
Back to Garage
Not an error screen. May have been is doing real work: a device that cannot reach the server genuinely does not know, and the copy refuses to claim otherwise.

04 · When the network, the OS, or the reader is the problem

None of these is the user's fault, and none of them is styled as though it were.
SYNC FAILING · PERSISTS, NO BADGE
▪ Not syncing: your server didn't answer. Your records are safe on this device. Retry
A sentence, never a raw error string — and attention, not critical: a server that did not answer is a fact, and the records really are fine. The second half of the sentence is the load-bearing half.
NOTIFICATIONS DENIED · ONCE, QUIETLY
Insurance renewalMapfre · Golf GTI
16 August 2026
Alerts are off. Turn on in iOS Settings ›
The alert line is replaced, not supplemented with a warning. Said once, on the card that would have alerted — not as a banner, and never again after.
NO PASSKEY ON THIS DEVICE · A REAL DEAD END
This device has no passkey for your account, and Koi has no way to enter a recovery code yet.
Stating a limitation rather than absorbing it into "just tap again". The recovery-code screen is proven server-side only; until it exists, the banner says exactly that and offers no false door.
LARGEST TEXT SIZE · REFLOW, NOT TRUNCATE
Odometer 91.240 km
Full tank yes
Every label→value pair stacks. The build fixes the label column at 118 pt and truncates instead — which turns an accessibility setting into data loss on the surface whose whole job is showing the math.

05 · The stress fixture

Long names, seven-digit odometers, four-digit amounts, a plate that does not fit. Drawn once, so the layouts are tested rather than assumed.
ROWS AT FULL STRETCH
Timing belt, water pump and auxiliary…1.284.500 km 1.284,60 €3 Jun
Estación de Servicio Carretera N-340…12,4 L/100km · 1.284 km 248,15 €28 May
The title truncates; the number never does. The money column is sized for seven characters plus a symbol and takes its width first — a clipped amount is a wrong amount, and a clipped station name is still a station name.
A CAR CARD THAT WILL NOT FIT
Mercedes-Benz Sprinter 316 CDI
Mercedes-Benz · 2021 · 0000-ZZZ
ALD Automotive 3.480/2.500 km Insurance in 3 days
Chips wrap, they never scroll and never truncate. A half-visible chip reading 3.480/2.5… is worse than no chip. The attention dot is flex-shrink: 0 — the one element on the card that must survive any name.
WHAT THIS ANNEX ASKS OF THE BUILD
Copy is data, not decoration

Every sentence on this sheet is a state the renderer has to select. They belong beside the query that produces the state — sixteen review-kind strings already live that way in the repo, unit-tested against the honesty rules, and that is the pattern to copy.

Three null-ish values, three renderings

Zero renders as a number. Unknown renders as a dash plus a sentence. Not applicable does not render at all. A single ?? '—' collapses all three into the one that lies most.

The test worth writing

Render every surface against a fixture with one field missing at a time, and assert that no output contains a bare dash, a zero the data does not support, or the word "error". That single test is most of §D5, and it is cheaper than reviewing for it forever.

Annex A to design batch 1. Every frame here is one of sheets 03–07's surfaces with one fact removed — collected separately so the primary sheets stay readable, and so this list can be checked against the renderer as a whole.
